The issue is about `translate_url()` creating incorrect URLs when optional named groups are missing in the URL pattern. Let me think about this...

When a URL has optional named groups (like `(?P<slug>[\w-]+)?`), and a URL is resolved without that group being present, `match.kwargs` will contain the key with a `None` value. When trying to reverse the URL with `kwargs={'slug': None}`, it might create an incorrect URL.
